title: Wavelet and Prototype Augmented Query-based Transformer for Pixel-level Surface Defect Detection
mechanism: Query-based mask transformer whose queries are refined by wavelet-domain cross-attention (high and low frequency) and prototype cross-attention for cluttered backgrounds.
adaptation: Benchmark arm: recent pixel-level defect method validated on cracks (CrackSeg9k) and patterned fabric (ZJU-Leaper); 1-channel stem, 24-way queries or per-class binary.
min_experiment: Benchmark run under the fixed protocol vs house; no kill line (reference row).
evidence: R: SOTA on ESDIs-SOD, CrackSeg9k, ZJU-Leaper. Code listed as github.com/yfhdm/WPFormer by a WebSearch summary, not opened.
prior_overlap: none; no mask-classification decoder was ever tried (section 5)
